WarPointsRewardDefinition.Name: BattleWon
WarPointsRewardDefinition.Formula: Property(EncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, VictoryLevel) * ( Property(EncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, DestroyedMilitaryPower) / 1000 + Clamp01(Property(EncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, EnemyHeroesKilledCount)) - Property(EncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, LostMilitaryPower) / 1000)

WarPointsRewardDefinition.Name: BattleLost
WarPointsRewardDefinition.Formula: Property(EnemyEncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, VictoryLevel) * ( Property(EnemyEncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, DestroyedMilitaryPower) / 1000 + Clamp01(Property(EnemyEncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, EnemyHeroesKilledCount)) - Property(EnemyEncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, LostMilitaryPower) / 1000) * -0.1
